chunks: We were told by my father, may Allah grant him mercy, that he said: We were told by Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Ali ibn al-Salt, [from Abdullah ibn al-Salt], from Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman, from those he mentioned, from Ubaidullah [ibn] al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The Straight Path is the Commander of the Believers, Ali (peace be upon him).
ai.seo_question: Who is identified as the Straight Path in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq in *Ma'ani al-Akhbar*, this hadith explicitly identifies Imam Ali (peace be upon him) as the 'Straight Path' (al-Sirat al-Mustaqim) mentioned in Surah Al-Fatiha, a concept central to Shia hermeneutics. It underscores the belief that true adherence to divine guidance is inextricably linked to recognizing and following the Imamate, positioning Ali as the living embodiment of the path to salvation.
